newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee buyers focus on Brazils, Centrals.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee buyers focus on Brazils, Centrals.

text.p: Cash coffee demand in Germany is focused on Nov/Dec Central American arabicas and Brazils while Colombians remain neglected, traders said.
Trading was thin on Friday, in between two holidays.
East Africans remained prohibitively expensive, with Kenyans rising $30 on the week per 50 kg fob to $415. Other arabicas dropped by $1-9 per 50 kg.
Robustas showed only modest price rises but failed to attract much buying interest.
Roasters' cover was adequate so that they shrugged off the effects of firm futures and high spot differentials.
